overview: We refresh how your app looks and feels without touching what works underneath. First we review your current screens and agree a visual direction, covering colors, type and icon style. Then we rebuild the screens as React Native components, keep your logic, accounts and data exactly as they are, and test on iPhone and Android. You also get a small style guide so future screens match.

faq: Will my app logic or data change?
No. We replace the look of the screens and keep your logic, accounts and stored data as they are. Users update the app and find the same content in a better layout.
Do you create mockups before building?
Yes. We share mockups of the first key screens for your approval, then build the rest in the same style. This keeps surprises low and your revision rounds focused.
Can you keep my existing brand?
Yes. Send your logo, colors and fonts and we work within them. If your brand is unfinished, we can suggest a palette and type pairing for you to approve.
Does a redesign need a new store release?
Yes, a redesign ships as an app update through the App Store and Google Play. We prepare the build and update text, and you or we upload it using your accounts.
